concerns.text: FR-009 requires including and utilizing an external kinetic dataset (≥20 molecules). Tasks T009d (Fetch), T009e (Verify), and T009f (Ingest) are marked as unchecked/failed. Without these, the dataset is missing, and SC-006 (proxy validation) cannot be measured.

FR-001 and SC-005 require logging memory adjustments and exclusion counts. Tasks T015 (Serialization), T016 (Validation), and T017 (Exclusion Report) are unchecked. T015 depends on T017, creating a blockage for the MVP data pipeline and preventing the generation of required artifacts.

FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, and FR-006 require implementing Spectral GNN, Heterophily GNN, Random Forest, training, and statistical tests. Tasks T018-T026 are all unchecked. This leaves the core modeling and evaluation requirements unimplemented.

FR-005 and FR-008 require feature attribution and validation against a curated reference set. Tasks T027-T034 are unchecked. Additionally, T033 (Proxy Validation) depends on the missing kinetic dataset (T009d-f), making it unexecutable.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Principle I (Reproducibility) require project structure and linting. Tasks T001a (data dirs), T001b (code dirs), and T003 (linting) are unchecked, leaving the foundational environment incomplete.

Tasks T009h, T030, and T033 contain comments like 'REMOVED' or 'MOVED FROM PHASE 5' but are still listed in the task list. While T030 and T033 are re-added later, T009h is marked removed but remains in the list, causing confusion. T030 and T033 appear twice (once in Phase 2, once in Phase 5) with conflicting status markers.
